snippet.title: Skate Style announcement trailer
snippet.description:
Demo out now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3862790/Skate_Style/

Music:
Getter - Leap of Faith

Skate Style is the next-generation skateboarding game! Create and share your style with your friends using the built-in animation editor. The game blends high-fidelity graphics and cutting edge animation techniques with an advanced character creator giving you full creative freedom. Whether you're hitting iconic street spots in Barcelona or flowing lines at Stalin Skate Plaza in Prague, every trick, every replay, and every style is yours to define.
